::: {.section-intro .fade-in}
Ratiomera is developed and maintained by volunteers. This page separates inquiries so that a message reaches the part of the project that can respond most usefully.

Use the general contact for questions about Ratiomera as a project, collaboration, institutional communication, or ideas that concern both branches. Use a branch contact for a correction, unclear explanation, content suggestion, accessibility observation, or other question tied specifically to Statistics or Mathematics. Use the volunteering contact when you want to offer time, language knowledge, subject expertise, accessibility review, design, or technical help.
:::

## Volunteer Availability

::: {.contact-note}
Ratiomera is volunteer-led and does not have a permanently staffed inbox or a guaranteed response time. Once working contact addresses are published, messages will be read as the relevant volunteers have capacity, and the time needed to respond may vary with the question and the stage of each branch's development. Ratiomera is not set up for urgent requests, individual tutoring, or time-sensitive assessment advice.

A clear message will help the team understand the request without unnecessary follow-up. For a correction or accessibility issue, include the exact page link and section, describe what seems unclear or incorrect, and, for a display problem, mention the device and browser you used. For a collaboration or volunteering inquiry, explain briefly what you would like to contribute, which branch or language it concerns, and whether the idea requires an answer by a particular date. Please do not send sensitive personal information, confidential student records, or unpublished assessment material.

The addresses shown on this page are active and route messages to the appropriate project mailbox or folder. A delayed response reflects the practical limits of a volunteer team working carefully across several parts of the platform. Thoughtful corrections and offers of help still matter.
:::
